Question: Let \(ABCD\) be a rectangle and let \(\overline{DM}\) be a segment perpendicular to the plane of \(ABCD.\) Suppose that \(\overline{DM}\) has integer length, and the lengths of \(\overline{MA},\) \(\overline{MC},\) and \(\overline{MB}\) are consecutive odd positive integers (in this order). What is the volume of pyramid \(MABCD?\)
